notes.title: Patch Notes for July 1st
notes.content:
Changes:

- New Save system.
- Dwarf slot purchase system.
- New music tracks.
- Updated story.
- Rewritten texts for better understanding.
- Icon system in the text to improve comprehension.
- Upreward now also activates reroll when leveling up.
- Boss balancing.
- Credits screen added.

Bugs:

-The game no longer crashes upon reaching the maximum progression level.
- Dwarf no longer dies in battle when you click on them.
- Game no longer crashes after defeating the necromancer boss.

notes.title: Update Notes for June 10th
notes.content:
**Changes:**

- Rework in metaprogression: we have updated all metaprogression levels with new rewards.
- Tutorial update: it now includes GIFs to facilitate understanding.
- You now earn a relic of your choice at the beginning of the run; this feature is a reward from metaprogression.
- White Flag System: if you lose a Raid with a flag, you can continue your run.
- Adjustments to some special battle effects.
- Minor UI and text improvements.
- Progress bar on the results screen: now you can see more clearly how far you got in the run.
- It's now possible to purchase dwarf slots.

**Bugs:**

- Dwarves no longer resurrect when pressing ESC during battle.
- The first shop of the run no longer offers overpriced dwarves.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 30th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese languages.
[*] Now, it is possible to see the Forge Tutorial.
[*] Battle results screen shows more detailed statistics.
[*] Balancing Bosses and Pets.
[*] Improvements in the notification system.
[*] Usability improvements.
[/list]


BUGS:
[list]
[*] Bug in the forge that prevented created weapons and armor from coming with skills.
[*] Crash that occurred when reaching level 30 of meta-progression.
[*] Crash when clicking on the dwarf inside card in inventory.
[*] Healer class dwarves start with a weapon.
[*] Fixed the issue that prevented the Necromancer from flying.
[*] It is no longer possible to smelt dwarves in the forge.
[*] Fixed the problem that closed the game when clicking on the dwarf's image in the inventory.
[/list]
